helpModal.title: Guide
helpModal.videoCoursesDescription: Watch our complete video tutorial series
helpModal.videoCoursesLearn: Learn how to use PanHandler with step-by-step video guides and real-world workflow examples.
helpModal.afterCapturing: After capturing your photo, calibrate using the reference coin to enable precise measurements.
helpModal.650CoinsWorldwide: 650+ coins from 130+ countries worldwide! Includes coins from every continent to ensure accessibility for everyone.
helpModal.zoomPosition: Zoom in and position the calibration circle
helpModal.matchEdges: Match the outside edge of the coin with the outside edge of the colored circle
helpModal.chooseMeasurement: Choose from multiple measurement types to capture all dimensions of your object.
helpModal.calculate3DVolumes: Calculate 3D volumes by adding depth measurements to your 2D area calculations.
helpModal.volumeStep1: Measure the area (Rectangle, Circle, or closed shape)
helpModal.closedFreeDrawLassos: Closed Free Draw Lassos - Irregular volumes
helpModal.importantFreeDraw: Important: For Free Draw lassos, the line cannot cross itself or the area (and volume) will not be calculated correctly.
helpModal.distanceDescription: Measure straight-line distances. Tap to place two points and get the distance between them. A gentle snap keeps lines horizontal and vertical automagically!
helpModal.distanceProTip: Pro Tip: Connect multiple lines by placing endpoints together to create triangles and polygons. Areas are automatically calculated and shown in the legend!
helpModal.angleDescription: Measure angles between two lines. Place first endpoint, then vertex (corner), then second endpoint.
helpModal.circleDescription: Measure circles by placing center and edge points. Shows radius, diameter, area, and optional volume.
helpModal.rectangleDescription: Measure rectangles by placing opposite corners. Shows width, height, area, and optional volume.
helpModal.freehandDescription: Draw custom paths to measure any shape. Perfect for wire paths, curved edges, or irregular contours.
helpModal.lassoModeSnap: When you draw close to your starting point, it auto-snaps to close the loop! You will feel haptic feedback when it connects.
helpModal.lassoModeArea: Closed loops show both perimeter AND area in the legend!
helpModal.freehandStep2: Place finger and hold for 1.5 seconds
helpModal.freehandGreatFor: Great for calculating wire paths in electrical projects, curved distances, or any non-straight measurement!
helpModal.pinchZoomDrag: Pinch to zoom, drag to pan
helpModal.tapPlacePrecision: Tap to place points with precision cursor
helpModal.precisionCursorDesc: Floating crosshair shows exactly where points will be placed
helpModal.eachMeasurementColor: Each measurement gets a unique color
helpModal.hideLabelsDesc: Toggle measurement labels off to view your photo clearly. Legend stays visible for reference
helpModal.swipeRightCollapse: Swipe right anywhere on menu to collapse it off-screen
helpModal.swipeLeftExpand: Swipe left to bring it back
helpModal.tapCollapseIcon: Or tap the collapse icon in the menu header
helpModal.tapSideTab: Tap side tab to bring menu back
helpModal.dragSideTab: Drag side tab up/down to reposition it
helpModal.menuCollapsesInstantly: Menu collapses instantly for quick workspace access
helpModal.afterPlacingMeasurements: After placing measurements, you can move and edit them while in Edit mode.
helpModal.moveDesc: Tap and drag circles, rectangles, or freehand paths to move them around
helpModal.editPointsDesc: Tap and drag any point to adjust measurements. Freehand paths can be reshaped by moving individual points!
helpModal.enableEditLabels: Enable "Edit labels" mode: Tap the "Edit labels" button in the legend, then tap any measurement label (the colored badge with numbers) to add or edit custom names
helpModal.labelsAppearOnSaves: Labels appear on saved photos and in email reports
helpModal.tap4TimesDelete: Tap any measurement 4 times rapidly (within 500ms each) to delete it. You will feel haptic feedback with each tap!
helpModal.exportPhotosReports: Export photos with measurements and detailed reports
helpModal.cadExport: CAD Export - 50% opacity for easy tracing
helpModal.referencePhoto: Reference Photo - Clean with scale info
helpModal.savedToAlbum: All saved measurements are automatically organized into a "PanHandler Measurements" album in your Photos app for easy access and sharing!
helpModal.proTip1: Auto-save enabled - Minimize the app anytime, resume your session later
helpModal.proTip2: Switch units anytime - Toggle between metric ⇄ imperial instantly
helpModal.proTip3: Use cursor guide - Measurement cursor appears above your finger for precise placement
helpModal.proTip4: Edit after placing - Move measurements or adjust individual points while in Edit mode
helpModal.proTip5: Quick delete - Tap any measurement (in edit mode) 4 times rapidly to delete it
helpModal.stressTestTitle: Add as many points as you want - you can't break it!
helpModal.photosNotSaving: Photos not saving or app freezing? Your device storage may be full. Delete old photos and videos from your Photos app to free up space. iOS needs available storage to process new images.
helpModal.appRunningSlow: App running slowly? Check your device storage. A full device can cause lag and freezing. Aim to keep at least 1-2 GB of free space.
helpModal.stillHavingIssues: Still having issues? Force-quit the app (swipe up from app switcher) and reopen. If problems persist, delete and reinstall the app for a fresh start.
helpModal.havingTrouble: Having trouble? Our support team is here to help!
helpModal.mapModeDesc: Measure real-world distances on maps, blueprints, and scaled drawings using coin calibration + map scale.
helpModal.bestForRoadMaps: Best for: Road maps, topo maps, property maps with verbal scale
helpModal.bestForDroneBlueprints: Best for: Drone photos, blueprints, floor plans, engineering drawings
helpModal.emailWorkflowDesc: Tap Email to generate a report with 2 photos and a detailed measurement table.
helpModal.shareVsEmail: Use the Share button to quickly send measurements via AirDrop, Messages, or any app. Use the Email button to send detailed reports with attachments.
helpModal.useCADCanvas: Use the CAD Canvas Photo to trace your measurements in any CAD software that supports canvas images.
helpModal.needToEnablePermissions: Need to enable permissions? Tap the button below to open PanHandler settings
helpModal.autoCapturedSaved: Auto-captured photos are automatically saved to both your Camera Roll AND a special "Auto-Leveled" album in Photos for easy access!
